records.description: Hoeschpark in Dortmund has a longstanding cruising-directory entry for a public toilet around Kirchderner Straße 37, close to the park. The old listing describes an entrance, internal facilities and daytime opening from about 08:00 to 18:00, but those details have not been confirmed against today's municipal toilet inventory. A March 2026 commenter praises the location and seeks company without describing an encounter. Earlier visitors reported mixed results, including visits when nobody was around. The park itself remains a normal public space, with walkers, sports facilities and other visitors. The essential details are still missing: whether this particular toilet is open, where its correct entrance is, when men actually attend and whether there has been any firsthand cruising activity in the last year. The old timetable should not be treated as a promise.
blockers: Specific toilet not verified as operational
2026 post is a solicitation, not a witnessed encounter
records.opening_notes: Old directory suggests 08:00–18:00; not confirmed with current municipal WC records.

records.description: The car park on Kalkumer Schlossallee in Düsseldorf-Kalkum sits beside a railway crossing and wooded paths, a little away from the busier city-centre cruising locations. Recent visitor accounts describe men meeting around the parking area and woodland in daylight. Posts from March, May and July 2026 include firsthand claims of successful meetings and regular activity, with contributors describing a mixture of younger and older men rather than one particular crowd. That doesn't guarantee you'll find somebody on arrival, and the location is still an ordinary public car park. There's an important practical complication: in September 2026 Düsseldorf offered around 1,000 square metres of the parking area for an electric-vehicle charging development. The construction timetable has not been established, so check current parking access and signage. Keep away from railway infrastructure, private property and closed paths, and respect other visitors.

records.description: The cruising-directory entry for Düsseldorf's Südfriedhof refers to toilets around the cemetery, but current municipal information identifies separate facilities near Am Südfriedhof 16 and Südring. Without a clearer description, it's uncertain which entrance the historical account meant. In July 2026 a first-person visitor reported a locked accessible cubicle, poor conditions and no apparent cruising activity. Older comments about late access and fixtures contradict the municipality's listed winter closing times, generally around 17:00. This is a cemetery with visitors and staff, not an unrestricted meeting venue, and it would be inappropriate to promise access outside posted hours. The available material does not establish a current cruising crowd, a best visiting period or even the precise toilet to recommend. The report is worth keeping as history, but not advertising as active.
blockers: Latest firsthand visit reports locked facility and no activity
Older all-night claim contradicted by official hours

records.description: BAT-Park, now generally called Gustav-Mahler-Park, is a small central Hamburg green space near the Alster transport corridor. It appears in both gay-szene and Planet Randy as a historic cruising location, but trimming and clearance of bushes in 2025 reportedly made the grounds much more exposed to passing pedestrians. One visitor in July 2026 noticed a few men standing and chatting, although he described little actual activity. Other recent historical accounts were similarly disappointing. That is some evidence of men still stopping there, but not enough to establish dependable cruising, a particular hour or a consistent age mix. The park is shared with commuters and local visitors, and its open sightlines make old claims of privacy especially unreliable. A newer firsthand encounter would be needed before treating it as an active recommendation.
blockers: Latest July 2026 visit described little activity
No reliable current crowd or peak time
records.tags: City Park, Central, Historical Cruising, Limited Privacy
records.opening_notes: Earlier guides suggest warmer evenings, but 2026 conditions do not support a dependable peak period.

records.description: Hummelsee sits towards Hamburg's northern edge near Hummelsbütteler Müllberge, Glashütter Landstraße and the boundary with Norderstedt. The outdoor area includes woodland paths, a rear car park and a lake used by ordinary walkers and naturists. Older gay directories describe men meeting around the quieter sections, particularly after work or when other visitors have gone, but a reliable current timetable is missing. A contributor writing in August 2026 said he had visited repeatedly after work and usually noticed one or two men. He did not describe a recent encounter; the clearest sexual-activity claim is from 2021. Expect a mixed-use recreation area rather than a guaranteed gay crowd, and stay on public paths and away from utility or private land. The location is plausible, but its present-day activity remains insufficiently verified.
blockers: 2026 firsthand observations establish only one or two men, not cruising encounters
Exact reliable meeting zone and crowd unknown
